data.one_liner: Automatically generates TypeAdapters for Hive to store custom classes.
data.what_it_does: Automatically generates TypeAdapters for Hive to store any class. It provides schema migration and generates a HiveRegistrar extension to register all generated TypeAdapters in one call.
use_when: You are using hive_ce for local storage and need to store custom Dart classes
You want automated TypeAdapter generation instead of writing them manually
avoid_when: You prefer runtime reflection or manual adapter writing without code generation
strengths: Automates TypeAdapter generation for custom classes
Supports generator annotations like GenerateAdapters and schema migration
weaknesses: Requires running a code generator setup
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up build_runner to run code generation for Hive adapters.
